central_bank.title: 1 · Central bank liquidity — Reserve Bank of Australia
central_bank.equivalence_note: Weekly A1 balance sheet + DAILY ES balances (A3): the AUD has a daily reserves series, closer to the Fed's H.4.1/daily data than CAD or GBP.

es_surplus_daily.label: Surplus ES balances (adjusted for late payments / minimum requirements)

sf_repos_surplus_rate.label: Open repo (standing facility at the ES rate) — operational, used for payments, NOT stress
sf_repos_surplus_rate.role: operational; usage < $5bn (Aug 2026); facility ceases early 2027 → parser must tolerate the column disappearing

sf_repos_margin.label: Overnight standing-facility repos at target + 25 bp (penalty)
sf_repos_margin.role: emergency gauge (Primary credit analogue): > 0 = flag, sustained = panic

omo_reverse_repos.label: Outstanding OMO reverse repos (liquidity provided by the RBA)
omo_reverse_repos.role: demand-driven full-allotment repos — quantity is not a policy signal

government_account.label: Australian Government deposits at the RBA

aud_investments.label: Australian dollar investments (AGS/semis held outright + repo)

omo_takeup_weekly.label: OMO weekly take-up: amount allotted (7d + 28d), by operation
omo_takeup_weekly.role: THE demand-driven signal: rising take-up = banks replacing declining reserves; surge > p90 = early friction before AONIA moves (RBA's own scarcity indicator #2)

apf_holdings_a31.label: RBA holdings of AGS and semis (run-off of the bond portfolio)

securities_lending.label: RBA securities lending (own + on behalf of AOFM)

fx_transactions.label: RBA net FX transactions / official reserve assets (A4 monthly; A5 daily intervention, rare)
fx_transactions.role: binary flag FX_OPERATION; not a regular liquidity tool today

net_liquidity.usd_analog: WALCL − TGA (no RRP analogue in Australia)
net_liquidity.label: Balance-sheet liquidity (assets − government deposits)
net_liquidity.note: kept as the cross-currency balance-sheet analogue; NOT the primary AUD reserves gauge (that is ES total vs the RBA demand estimate + price). State-government deposits exist in A1 but are immaterial (< $50m).

es_balances_dod.note: daily reserve impulse — mirrors fiscal flows and OMO on the day

omo_share_of_es.note: repo-supplied share of ES; RBA Aug-2026: OMO $20–30bn outstanding vs ES ~$200bn. Escalates only with price confirmation

balance_sheet_phase.formula: QT if aud_investments falling 13w AND omo not rising, else NORMALIZATION/STEADY

primary_absolute.range_name: RBA estimate of banks' demand for reserves in an ample regime
primary_absolute.source: Jacobs, 'The Road to Ample', 2026-08-25: demand estimated $70–100bn (was $100–200bn in 2024); ES ~$200bn Aug 2026
primary_absolute.above_range_note: > 100bn = ample; the RBA explicitly does not target a level — scarcity is read in PRICE (AONIA vs target, OMO take-up)
primary_absolute.in_range_note: inside 70–100bn = approaching ample; informational WATCH, escalate only with price/OMO confirmation
primary_absolute.review_rule: re-check at every RBA speech/SMP that updates the demand estimate

reserves.percentile_note: no percentile on the LEVEL (structural decline under run-off); percentiles on es_balances_dod, reserves_wow_pct, and on es_surplus_daily wow since 2025-02 (ample-reserves regime window), not 3y

sf_repos_margin.origin: any penalty-rate standing facility use = flag (analogue of Advances > 0)

derived_v04.omo_dealt_daily / omo_matured_daily / om: A3 transaction details per operation: + value on the deal date, − at deal + term; cut at the last operation (weekly)
derived_v04.omo_stock_daily: principal outstanding from operations; omo_stock_vs_a3_error vs AORROMO (interest included; ≈ 0.1 %)
derived_v04.omo_takeup_7d / omo_takeup_28d / omo_wa_: A3: take-up by term and weighted-average spread per operation day
derived_v04.omo_unwinds_next_4w / unwinds_vs_implied: A4: RBA published unwind schedule (ARRRUNW) and its reconciliation with dealt + term
derived_v04.components_v04: shadow: omo_net_5d_pct, omo_takeup_week_pct, omo_stock_share (% of ES balances)

fiscal.title: 2 · Treasury / fiscal equivalent — Australian Government deposits at the RBA, AOFM, Department of Finance
fiscal.equivalence_note: Government deposits at the RBA are WEEKLY (A1) — a true TGA analogue at weekly resolution (better than GBP, worse than CAD's daily Receiver General). Issuance/tenders from AOFM (event). Monthly financial statements from Finance for the NFA flow.

government_account.label: Australian Government deposits at the RBA (weekly)

aofm_bond_tenders.label: AOFM Treasury Bond tenders: amount, coverage ratio, weighted avg yield

tnotes_on_issue.label: Treasury Notes on issue (AOFM, weekly estimate)
tnotes_on_issue.role: short-term fiscal drain alongside AOFM term deposits

ags_redemptions.label: AGS maturity calendar (large redemptions > $20bn = fiscal event)

fiscal_flow_weekly.sign: positive = government deposits fell = net injection into ES balances (spending/redemptions > receipts/issuance)

net_issuance_event.formula: sum(tender amounts) per week − maturities (pending AOFM parser)

derived.mmt_note: Spending creates NFA; taxes destroy NFA; AGS issuance drains ES balances without changing NFA. Government deposits at the RBA are the only weekly window on the fiscal flow; tax dates (monthly BAS, quarterly company tax) and bond settlements drive large swings — annotate seasonality. Early-September jumps are NOT BAS (Kimi): read them as AOFM cash/term-deposit management or issuance settlement.

fiscal_big_week.note: seasonally annotated: 21st monthly PAYG/GST, 28th after quarter-end BAS, company tax instalments, super guarantee 28 Jul/Oct/Jan/Apr, EOFY 30-Jun (cash rebuild Jul–Oct), AOFM cash-buffer management — none of these is scarcity

derived_v04.tn_matured / tib_matured / buybacks_sett: notes and indexed bonds by maturity (+ nominal); buybacks by Date Settled (+ proceeds; RBA transfers excluded)

banking.title: 3 · Banking transmission — RBA financial aggregates (D1/D2/D3)
banking.equivalence_note: Monthly, ~1-month lag; D1 = growth rates, D2 = levels of lending/credit, D3 = monetary aggregates. APRA's D2A reporting decommission may delay financial aggregates (RBA notice, Sep 2026) → status degraded-by-design until confirmed. No weekly H.8 analogue.

credit_total_mom.label: Credit; Total excluding financial businesses — monthly growth %

transmission_signal.rule: green if ≥3 of {credit total, housing, business, M3, broad money} growth > 0 with z ≥ 0; red if ≥3 z ≤ −1; NO SIGNAL if < 3 valid

banking.code_policy: series ids resolved from the CSV 'Series ID' header row at ingest (parse by column name, never by position); fail loudly if an id disappears

rates.title: 4 · Rates & money market — cash rate corridor, BBSW/OIS, AGS curve
rates.equivalence_note: F1 daily: target, actual interbank overnight cash rate (with high/low and volume), BBSW 1/3/6M, OIS 1/3/6M, T-notes; F2 daily AGS 2/3/5/10Y. Corridor known from A2.

es_rate.label: ES rate (rate paid on surplus ES balances) = target − 10 bp

overnight_repo_rate.label: Overnight standing-facility repo rate = target + 25 bp

overnight_minus_target_bps.note: PRIMARY stress spread. Under OMO at +10, AONIA is anchored AT target (RBA: private overnight repo ~+2 bp, Aug 2026). ≥ +3 early flag; ≥ +5 three sessions = STRESS; ≥ +15 = CRISIS (ceiling +25). Also flag the LOW side: AONIA ≤ target − 5 persistent = excess (not scarcity)

overnight_minus_es_rate_bps.note: secondary: distance from the floor (normal ≈ +10). CodeWord/Qwen asked to anchor here; kept secondary because AONIA is anchored at target since 2025 (Kimi), band_position covers it

bbsw_minus_target_bps.note: funding-stress proxy while OIS is unavailable; PRIMARY = rolling percentile (750d) because the level embeds expected hikes/cuts; absolute secondary 30/45/70

secondary_absolute.origin: AONIA normally within ±2 bp of target; +25 = ceiling (standing facility)

bbsw_minus_target_bps.rule: absolute is binding for STRESS/CRISIS; percentile alone caps at WATCH (BBSW−target embeds rate expectations: a hiking cycle is p99 but not funding stress)
bbsw_minus_target_bps.origin: v0.2.2 after first live run (p98.9 at 27 bp)

rates.note_f2: F2 values are daily but the file is updated WEEKLY with ~2-business-day lag (Kimi, verified: last row 2026-09-02 on 2026-09-08); F1 is daily. Curve cards carry 'weekly' cadence; semis yields removed from F2 in 2023 → unavailable

derived_v04.tn_wa_yield / tn_yield_minus_target_bps: A6: Treasury Note tender yield vs the cash rate target (context)

regime.weights_note: v0.2: kept 0.40/0.25/0.25/0.10 — reviewers split (Qwen/Claude 0.15–0.20 fiscal, CodeWord ≥0.30, Kimi/DeepSeek/Perplexity 0.25). Median = proposal. Recalibrate with live history (regime.calibration).

rules.LIQUIDITY_SCARCITY: surplus ES balances at/below p10 (156w) AND overnight_minus_target_bps ≥ STRESS persistent (or sf_repos_margin > 0)
rules.FLOOR_FRICTION: ES ample AND overnight_minus_target_bps ≥ WATCH persistent
rules.LIQUIDITY_DRAIN: general regime: central bank AND treasury both DRAIN, or dual-weighted score ≤ drain threshold (regime.dual)
rules.LIQUIDITY_INJECTION: general regime: both INJECTION, or dual-weighted score ≥ injection threshold (regime.dual)
rules.NEUTRAL: otherwise (including unresolved conflicts inside the thresholds)

orthogonal_flags.STANDING_FACILITY_USED: sf_repos_margin (+25 bp) > 0 — NOT the open repo at the ES rate

calibration.method: same as GBP: after ≥26 weeks live, grid over weights scored against price-confirmed stress (AONIA ≥ target+5, OMO take-up surges)
